definitions.explanation: An inner awareness of and commitment to fulfilling one's duties and obligations. A character trait highly valued in Japanese social and professional life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{責任感|せきにんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: He has a strong sense of responsibility.

examples.japanese: {責任感|せきにんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せたい→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: I want to entrust it to someone with a sense of responsibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{責任感|せきにんかん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Out of a sense of responsibility as leader, I stayed at the site until the very end.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (responsibility) and ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense, feeling). Describes the internal quality of taking one's duties seriously. Frequently mentioned in job interviews, character references, and evaluations.

USAGE:
Very commonly paired with ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong) or ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have). In Japanese work culture, {責任感|せきにんかん} is one of the most valued personal qualities and frequently appears in job postings and self-introductions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {責任感|せきにんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ — to have a strong sense of responsibility
- {責任感|せきにんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a responsible person
- {責任感|せきにんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧ — to lack a sense of responsibility
- {責任感|せきにんかん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ — out of a sense of responsibility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {使命感|しめいかん} — sense of mission (stronger, more purposeful)
- ⟦{義務感|ぎむかん}→義務感：21551_gimukan⟧ — sense of duty (more obligation-focused)
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ — responsibility (the actual duty, not the feeling)
